title: Endium Expansion
description: Endium Expansion is a high-tier progression mod that introduces Endium, a rare and powerful material found only in the End dimension. This mod is designed to add a new level of gear progression beyond Netherite, rewarding players who brave the dangers.
body:
🔹 How to Get Endium
 

 

Step 1: Mine Endium Ore

Deep within the End lies Endium Ore, a rare and valuable block that can only be found in the outer islands. It requires a Netherite pickaxe to mine.

Step 2: Smelt into Endium Scrap

Smelting Endium Ore in a furnace or blast furnace yields Endium Scrap, a crucial ingredient in crafting Endium Ingots.
![Smelting Endium Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d7d24a38142fbbade84ee14616ecb1838ae452f.png)

Step 3: Craft Endium Ingots

In a crafting table, combine 5 Endium Scrap and 5 Eyes of Ender to produce 1 Endium Ingot. This step ensures Endium remains an Endgame resource, both literally and mechanically.

![Crafting Endium Ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65ce2257028f7d2d35fe19e8c7cf2c67cc594a01.png)
 

 

 

🔹 Upgrading to Endium Gear
 

 

New Drop: Endium Upgrade Template

Shulkers now have a chance to drop Endium Upgrade Templates upon death. These rare templates are required to upgrade gear.

Smithing Table Upgrade

To upgrade your gear, use:

 

1 Endium Upgrade Template

1 Endium Ingot

Any piece of Netherite armor or tool

 

Place these into a smithing table to create Endium Gear.


 ![Upgrading to Endium tier](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a43736339d18cb75c7cbf1e2ec671fcaaa6bc1df.png)

 

 

🔹 Why Use Endium?
 

 

Endium gear is significantly stronger than Netherite, offering:

 

Higher durability

Increased damage (tools)

Improved protection (armor)

Built-in knockback resistance and more (depending on your configuration)

 

 

This mod maintains vanilla balance by requiring Netherite as a prerequisite and making Endium both resource-intensive and hard to obtain.
